game.name: Boot into Ollie OS
game.desc: Restart into Ollie OS, a small desktop with a web browser. Anything you save in its Downloads folder is sorted into your ROM folders when you come back to Etros. Restart Ollie OS, or hold SELECT + START, to return here.

game.name: Boot into Windows 11
game.desc: Restart into Windows 11 (Raspberry Pi 5, experimental). It has no internet and is slow. Install it first from Ollie OS (Install Windows 11 on its desktop). To come back, use Back to Etros on Windows's desktop.

game.name: Sort downloaded ROMs
game.desc: Move ROMs from /userdata/downloads into the folder for their console. Files whose console can't be told from the name (.bin, .iso, .cue, .chd, arcade .zip) stay in downloads for you to move yourself. This also happens on every boot.
